pr_title: fix(devtools): ensure that inspected component label is always in the viewport
pr_body:
Currently the label showing the component name is always positioned from the bottom/right edge of the element which may be outside of the viewport. These changes add some logic to fall back to a different position so that the label is always visible.

I've also cleaned the `highlighter.ts` file up a bit.

Fixes #48479.
pr_comments: @AleksanderBodurri I played around with it a bit and I think that the current approach has a better UX, compared to reducing the height of the container. The problem with reducing the height is that some elements can be very slim and can have their content covered up by the label like in this example:
This PR was merged into the repository by commit 3a59de681fd9899a40c49b3bce6f101d3d1b95cd.

review_comments: Note that a far simpler way of fixing the issue would've been to reduce the size of the container element so it's never outside of the viewport. I felt like this approach offers a better experience, because the container accurately reflects the size of the element you're inspecting.
How did we arrive at 23 for this offset? Can we leave a comment explaining this constant?
The 23 was hardcoded already, I just had to move it out so that I could use it in the calculations.
